top_signals.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Nov. 4
top_signals.summary: Oil edged lower, extending a two-day decline as traders weighed signs of de-escalation from the US while results from key midterms elections rolled in.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: European Defense Stocks Slide as Democrats’ Sweep Dents Optimism
top_signals.summary: European defense stocks slid as the Democrats’ landslide midterm-elections win dented expectations of a further ramp-up in US military spending.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
